title: fields 包 README 与 FieldEditWidget 注释仍说「表格没开单元格选择时富文本在格子上方打开、等表格的保存按钮」，#35827 之后已不成立（接 #35827）
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Ca6EBDpTBZk8v46Jjv

Filing gate: ① release-text exception (shipped package text that a release fixes in place), from the seat's contract-tier L2 on PR #37437 (#35827), record 7189751333; filed by the owning zone under the parent. Source: reviewer.
Grading: area:ux · Bug · p2 (triage grades) · reach: `ui/packages/fields/README.md` ships in the package (`files[]`), read by every host developer of `@object-ui/fields` · evidence: L2 record 7189751333.

## 维护者速读

- 做什么：#35827 下掉了表格的暂存批量保存。fields 包随包发布的 README 和 FieldEditWidget 里的注释还在说「表格没开单元格选择时，富文本编辑框在格子上方打开，文字留给表格的保存按钮」，这已经不对了。改正文字，并查一下那段「格子上方打开」的分支是否已经走不到。
- 谁受益：读包文档的宿主开发者。
- 不做会怎样：随包发布的文档描述一个已经没有的行为。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- `ui/packages/fields/README.md:145-149` and `ui/packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx:216-219` (lines at PR #37437 head deefadb3) say a grid without `cellSelection` opens the rich-text box over the cell and keeps the text for the grid's save buttons. After #35827 a grid is always select-first and has no staged save buttons.
- Correct both texts. Check whether the over-the-cell branch behind those lines is now unreachable; if it is, retire it with its tests (or say why it stays).

## Acceptance

- Both texts describe the current behaviour; the branch is retired with a pin, or kept with the reason recorded.

Blocked-by: #35827
